text:
eli_partnerships: FYI OrionRack just reported a manifest short on CNTR-AZ-778. APAC reserved pool for SKU RWD-1000 is short ~48 units. This hits marketplace reserved commitments + a Dedicated pilot for FinServe. Need options.

inventory-bot: Alert: reservation vs on_hand mismatch
SKU: RWD-1000 | region: APAC | reserved: 160 | on_hand: 112 | missing: 48 | snapshot: 2026-03-21T10:05:00Z :rotating_light:

olivia_fin: what's the $ impact if we air-ship? Jump to finance pls.

maria_logistics: Pulling PO 4512 and container, contacting carrier. If short-pick we can request split air-LTL for 48 units ETA 3 days, cost +25%. Alternative: swap 48 units with RWD-1000X from EU pool and do cross-dock. Need product compatibility sign-off.

john_hw_ops: RWD-1000X uses different firmware and has slightly lower throughput on large-context workloads. Product must confirm no regression for FinServe Dedicated pilot. We can also cap context length temporarily.

sara_pm: We have marketplace launch assets queued 03/30. Recommend holding public assets until commit resolved. Can we soft-launch regionally?

kai_account_mgr: Customers impacted: FinServe (64 units), CloudSpan (32), PilotSI (16). FinServe highest risk. If we ship hybrid (original + substitute) need their explicit ok; prepping outreach.

eli_partnerships: Running quick query to confirm reservations: `rwd-cli reservations export --sku RWD-1000 --region apac --out csv` — will attach.

inventory-bot: Quick result: reserved CSV attached (ref:rsv-2366008888.csv) — confirm owners before external comms.

maria_logistics: Carrier says manifest short due to pallet QC hold on supplier line. They can release 24 units on this vessel and 24 on next vessel (ETA 2026-04-02). Air-LTL covers up to 40 units by 2026-03-25 at +25% cost. EU interchange possible for 48 units but adds customs/leadtime.

olivia_fin: +25% COP for 40 units is within war chest if we reprioritize Q1 marketing budget. Need CFO sign-off but provisional ok.

john_hw_ops: Product triage: @sara_pm @eli_partnerships loop in @product_edge to validate RWD-1000X perf delta within 24h.

sara_pm: Drafting customer note with mitigations: air-LTL at our expense, temporary swap to RWD-1000X with perf caveat, or small SLA credit. Will post sample here.

kai_account_mgr: I'll contact FinServe PM and CloudSpan lead privately. Offer: cover air-LTL for customer-critical; others get temporary Hosted Dedicated pool.

eli_partnerships: Decision matrix: (1) Approve air-LTL for 40 units -> covers FinServe + CloudSpan partial. (2) Swap 8 units from EU pool to close gap -> customs risk. (3) Delay public marketplace announcement.

maria_logistics: Please RT container ASN: ASN01234567, PO: PO-4512. Carrier DM'ed air-LTL manifest.

olivia_fin: CFO verbal ok for up to +30% one-off shipping for customer-critical. Send final quote for formal sign-off.

product_edge: Quick check: RWD-1000X quant-profile differs; observed ~8-12% throughput drop on 16k contexts but quality parity within eval thresholds. Recommend swap only if customer accepts slight perf note.

sara_pm: Customer draft below — feedback?
`Hi [Name], quick update: due to a supplier manifest short we can offer expedited air delivery (ETA 3 days) or a temporary swap to RWD-1000X. If we cannot meet your date we will issue a 3% service credit. Please advise by EOD.`

kai_account_mgr: Sending to FinServe now.

eli_partnerships: OK: Proceed with air-LTL for 40 units to cover FinServe + partial CloudSpan. Use EU interchange only if customer rejects. Hold marketplace launch until physical delivery or written customer approvals confirmed. I'll coordinate with Orion and ops.

maria_logistics: Air-LTL booked. Flight manifest ref: FLT-8892. ETA 2026-03-25. Cost delta +24%.

inventory-bot: Reservation update after booking: reserved:160 | on_hand:152 | in_transit_air:40 | pending_supplier:24 | snapshot:2026-03-21T13:02:00Z

sara_pm: Messaging sent to FinServe. They replied: "We appreciate the proactive fix; accept air-LTL. Can you confirm SLA credit clause?"

olivia_fin: Confirm SLA credit clause 3% approved.

eli_partnerships: Closing loop: marketplace announcement paused, air-LTL confirmed, product signed off on RWD-1000X as backup. Will post final shipment receipts when landed. Thanks all. :tada:
